Dear Sir, 
 
Sub:- Audio Link of Results Conference Call for Q2 FY 27  
Further to our letter dated 27th October, 2026, we write to inform you that the Audio Link of the 
Q2FY27 Results Conference Call held on Monday, 2nd November, 2026 at 17:00 hrs (IST) has been 
made available on the website of the Company and can be accessed at the link: 
https://www.pcblltd.com/investor-relation/financials/investor-presentation .  
We request you to please take the afore-mentioned information on record and oblige.
